# LP Skills

Portable Agent Skills for Uniswap and Aerodrome liquidity provision.

Includes connection setup, pool analysis, exact planning, position monitoring, wallet-safe operation, integration engineering, backtesting, automation and custody, atomic position actions, and share-based v4 hooks. No hosted LP agent service is required.

## Install

npx skills add https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills/tree/main/packages/lp
npm install --global galleon-lp-skills

## Skill entrypoints

- skills/lp-setup/SKILL.md: verify read access and map required tools
- skills/lp-analyze/SKILL.md: compare pools and assess risk before deployment
- skills/lp-research/SKILL.md: install-compatible rename notice for lp-analyze
- skills/lp-plan/SKILL.md: produce an exact unsigned position plan
- skills/lp-monitor/SKILL.md: inspect a live position and decide whether action is justified
- skills/lp-execute/SKILL.md: execute an explicitly requested action through a user-controlled wallet
- skills/lp-operate/SKILL.md: install-compatible rename notice for lp-execute
- skills/lp-engineer/SKILL.md: build and review protocol integrations

## Machine interfaces

- package: galleon-lp-skills
- CLI: lp-skills
- Uniswap interface link: lp-skills uniswap-link --help
- discovery schema: https://schemas.agentskills.io/discovery/0.2.0/schema.json
- source: https://github.com/galleonlabs/crypto-defi-skills

## Optional VFAT resource

Public yield screening: https://vfat.io/yield
Official sources: https://github.com/vfat-io
Role-specific VFAT references live inside each canonical skill. They cover APR definitions, Sickle custody, automation, fee bases and verified access limits. No provider is installed or required.
